title: Autopsy Study Finds Replicating SARS-CoV-2 in the Hearts of Long Covid
summary: A post-mortem study revealing that SARS-CoV-2 virus actively replicates in the hearts of Long Covid patients, providing scientific evidence for persistent cardiac symptoms in post-acute COVID syndrome. This research offers potential mechanistic explanation for cardiovascular complications observed in Long Covid cases.
problem_solved: Explains the underlying mechanism of cardiac symptoms in Long Covid patients through evidence of viral persistence and active replication in heart tissue.
why_valuable: This research bridges the gap between clinical observations of Long Covid cardiac symptoms and biological evidence, potentially guiding future therapeutic interventions for millions affected by post-acute COVID complications.
